why: The plugin is mostly queue and herd mechanics for its own multi-session workflow, so 26 of 33 units are kept as skills and 7 persona units in skills/herder/SKILL.md (the cat voice) are dropped as not being work rules. Two conflicts matter, both hard stops: skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md (Limits) lets a reviewer retry a refused action on its own judgement, and skills/herd/roles/worker.md says the reviewer may do the same. That cuts against the reader's rule never to run anything destructive without an explicit go-ahead, because a refusal is exactly where a destructive action would be blocked. Three ideas are new and worth keeping: split a diff that mixes refactor and behaviour change, name the failure you fear and then try to produce it (listing what was not checked), and report raw observations rather than a verdict. The rest of the scope and debt-marker guidance duplicates the reader's engineering rules 4 and 5.
do_this: Install only with changes: remove or rewrite the two retry-a-refused-action passages in skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md and skills/herd/roles/worker.md so a refusal is never retried without the reader's explicit go-ahead.
Skip or disable the herder persona skill (skills/herder/SKILL.md) if you do not want cat voice in replies.
Use the queue, capture and herd skills only in sessions where you want that workflow; they add nothing to ordinary work.
Copy the three new standing rules from the patch into your engineering rules rather than relying on the reviewer and worker role files to carry them.
Do not copy the scope and debt-marker items, since your rules already cover them.
patch:
Add these to examples/reader/rules/engineering.md, after the existing numbered rules, in the same style:

```diff
+6. A diff that both restructures code and changes behaviour is a finding: split the refactor out and land it first.
+7. Before calling work verified, name the failure you fear ("I claim X; the failure I fear is Y"), try to produce it, and list what you did not check.
+8. Report what you observed, not the verdict: paste the raw command, exit code and output, and leave "verified" to the reviewer.
```
